mapper.select: select r.roleId ,r.role from EmployeeRole er inner join RolesInfo r on er.roleId=r.roleId where er.empId=#{empId};

mapper.update: update EmployeeInfo set password=#{password},firstLoginStatus=1 where email=#{email};
mapper.insert: insert into ConfirmationToken(token,tokenCreationDate,tokenExpiryDate,empId) values(#{token},#{tokenCreationDate},#{tokenExpiryDate},(select empId from EmployeeInfo where email=#{user.email}))
